title: Homebridge Accessory Failure Rate
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homebridge:accessory
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(accessory_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by accessory_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Homebridge accessory records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each accessory.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize accessory_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per accessory.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It regularly which parts of your Homebridge accessory data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
